title: Are you actually training, or just exercising? 👀
hook: Are you actually training, or just exercising? 👀
caption:
Are you actually training, or just exercising? 👀

There’s a difference.

A good training programme should have a purpose behind it — not just a collection of exercises thrown together.

You should know:

➡️ What you’re doing
➡️ Why you’re doing it
➡️ How hard you should be working
➡️ How you’re progressing
➡️ When it’s time to adapt

If you can’t answer those questions, it might be time to look at your training differently.

Train with purpose. Progress with structure.

Marsh Method | Online Coaching

title: Here is a tool for the next time you feel yourself spiraling, shutting down, or abandoning yourself when things get big and scary.
hook: Here is a tool for the next time you feel yourself spiraling, shutting down, or abandoning yourself when things get big and scary.
caption:
Here is a tool for the next time you feel yourself spiraling, shutting down, or abandoning yourself when things get big and scary. 

Stop. Notice. Stay.

Stop: both feet on the floor, one slow breath. Notice: what am I actually feeling right now? Don't fix it. Don't explain it away. Just name it. Stay: can I stay with myself while I feel this?

That's it. You don't have to love the feeling or solve it in that moment.

Try this: "I can feel this and still be safe. I can feel this and still be here."
